groups.defect: The common-prefix and common-suffix counts in the diff-trimming code are computed independently and can overlap, so substring(start, length-end) throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same prefix/suffix trimming loops and substring calls and propose clamping the bounds.

groups.defect: The JS account-ui and admin-ui English bundles switched error-invalid-multivalued-size from i18next {{n}} placeholders to MessageFormat {n}/choice syntax. The frontend will not interpolate these, and the sibling translations still use {{n}}.
groups.rationale: The same placeholder-syntax change was made in both JS bundles, and every member reports it as breaking frontend interpolation or the translation contract. Reverting to the {{n}} syntax in both files fixes it.

groups.defect: The Lithuanian account (totpStep1) and login (loginTotpStep1) bundles were given an Italian sentence instead of a Lithuanian translation.
groups.rationale: The same copy-paste mistake appears in two Lithuanian files, and each needs its own edit.
